title: The completion of a Noetherian local ring has the same dimension
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring and $A^\wedge=\varprojlim_nA/\mathfrak m^n$ its $\mathfrak m$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] (a Noetherian local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak mA^\wedge$). Then the Krull dimensions agree: $\dim A^\wedge=\dim A$ (both finite).

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NV (lemma-completion-dimension), and its proof: A/m^n = A^/m^n A^ (Algebra Lemma 05GG), equal Hilbert functions, Algebra Proposition 00KQ (dimension = degree of the Hilbert polynomial); or the alternative given there: Algebra Lemma 00ON (lemma-dimension-base-fibre-equals-total) for the flat local map A -> A^ (Algebra Lemma 00MC) whose closed fibre A^/mA^ = A/m is a field
